text: You'll love Linda's Chunky Garlic Mashed Potatoes, and it's a great fit for your dietary needs. The recipe is gluten-free, so you don't have to worry about any gluten-containing ingredients. The dish is also relatively quick to make, taking about 55 minutes to prepare, which fits within your 60-minute time budget. As a bonus, potatoes are one of your stated preferences, and the addition of roasted garlic and sour cream adds a rich and creamy flavor that's sure to satisfy your taste buds.
